description.value: White Spot is BC's oldest restaurant chain, operating since 1928 and built on locally sourced Canadian beef, BC chicken, and BC-grown produce. The Kitsilano location sits on West Broadway in one of Vancouver's most cycling-active neighbourhoods, offering dine-in, a patio, curbside pickup, and third-party delivery. A well-known comfort-food institution, it draws families and regulars alike with a broad menu and deep local roots.
